raw.title: fix: fail xpath criteria on null context per spec 5.8.11.4.4
raw.body:
fix: fail xpath criteria on null context per spec 5.8.11.4.4

The Arazzo spec requires a criterion whose context evaluates to null or
undefined to fail. The xpath arm instead treated a null context as a
signal to evaluate against the raw response body, which could pass. It
now mirrors the jsonpath arm's null guard, with no body fallback, and
the trace context value stays null instead of being rewritten.

Non-UTF-8 bodies fail closed (strict UTF-8 decoding in eval_context
means $response.body never resolves for them) — pinned by test and
recorded in audit finding F22 with the charset question left open. The
regex arm shares the null-context violation via empty-string coercion;
recorded as F23, not fixed here. One pre-existing helper test had
accidentally pinned the fallback by omitting response_body from its
EvalContext; corrected to mirror engine wiring.
